A '''companion of Clarrisa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he decided to take [[Clarrisa]] on a surprise vacation to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. However, when they arrived, Clarrisa was furious at him for taking her to such a inhospitable world.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Clarrisa's companion was a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on December 15, 2011.

When examined, his name only appeared as "an unhappy tourist."
